comment: Row 19 calls the implementation approach "outstanding" and endorses WHO providing the blueprint while national organisations design their own architecture. Row 32 says the approach is too top-down and national authorities should be involved in shaping implementation. Both are submitted as separate numbered comments and WHO reviewers will read them as inconsistent.

public.text: Row 19 calls the implementation approach "outstanding" and endorses WHO providing the blueprint while national organisations design their own architecture. Row 32 says the approach is too top-down and national authorities should be involved in shaping implementation. Both are submitted as separate numbered comments and WHO reviewers will read them as inconsistent.
public.suggestedRevision: (a) Merge into one comment — endorse the division of responsibility but ask that national authorities be engaged in shaping the implementation plan rather than receiving it; (b) keep row 19 and drop row 32; (c) keep row 32 and drop row 19. Option (a) is recommended as it preserves both points without contradiction.
